notes: Strict current Blagny AOC specifications from the cahier des charges homologated by the arrêté of 8 June 2026. Blagny is red only. The executable positive path remains 100% Pinot Noir: Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris are mixed-planting accessory varieties, while César is subject to an operator-specific convention and therefore is not promoted as a generic blend authorization.

blagny_cahier_2026.authority: Ministère de l'Agriculture, de l'Agro-alimentaire et de la Souveraineté alimentaire
blagny_cahier_2026.title: Cahier des charges de l'AOC Blagny homologué par l'arrêté du 8 juin 2026
blagny_cahier_2026.scope: Current published specification: red-only status, seven Premier Cru climats, encépagement, maturity, yields, malic acid, fermentable sugar, total alcohol, élevage and release dates.

specs.notes: Conservative 100% Pinot Noir positive path. Chardonnay, Pinot Blanc and Pinot Gris are authorized only as mixed plantings, jointly <=15% per parcel. César is conditional on a specific convention and is not promoted. Oak pieces and continuous presses are prohibited, and irrigation is prohibited; these negative rules await first-class executable fields.

Conservative 100% Pinot Noir Premier Cru path. The seven authorized climat names are evaluated separately by SiteClaimRegistry. Mixed-planting accessories and convention-dependent César are not promoted as generic cellar-blend paths.
